sentences.text:
1. Heard Shri Satendra Kumar Upadhyay, learned counsel for the applicant and Shri S.D.Shukla,
learned AGA for the State.

2. This application under Section 528 BNSS has been preferred for quashing of the entire proceedings, including impugned order dated 07.12.2021, of Case No.221 of 2007 (State Vs. Satrya Prakash), under Section 10/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, Police Station Dibai, District Bulandshahar, pending in the Court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Anup Sahar,
District Bulandshahar.

sentences.text: 3. It is contended by learned counsel for the applicant that the case under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act is of the year 2007, in which, the applicant is an accused.

He further submits that the accused kept on attending the learned trial Court regularly but due to Covid-19, he was under the impression that his case was withdrawn by the prosecution and under this misconception, he could not appear before the learned trial Court and a non bailable warrant was issued on 07.12.2021.

He prays that the order issuing non bailable warrant is set aside.
4.
On the other hand learned AGA submits that due to non appearance of the applicant on several dates, the leaned trial Court proceeded to issue non bailable warrant against the applicant.

5. In view of aforesaid, it is directed that in case, applicant appears/ surrenders before the court below within a period of three weeks from today and participate in the trial, then the learned trial Court shall not execute the non bailable warrant against him.

It is further directed that if the applicant fails to appear within the aforesaid period and does not cooperate in the trial, then the learned Court concerned shall proceed to execute the non bailable warrant against the applicant.
